paper_derived_rule_baseline.reference: Jeong and Yang, Applied Sciences 2025, 15, 9551, Tables 2-5 and Equation (1)

comparison: The fixed paper-derived scorecard accumulates risk and requires MFA; the profile-calibrated proposed model applies stronger field concentration and blocks. One synthetic case does not establish superiority.
limitations: The paper calls this a Trust Score model; this project uses its deterministic score tables and fixed weights as a rule baseline.
Latency-to-network-stability and aggregate device-health mappings are project proxies.
Ten unobserved sub-metrics receive favorable normal scores.
Company replay labels and policy costs are required to decide whether MFA or blocking is the better action.
